title: prunus communis subsp. divaricata
intro: Prunus communis subsp. divaricata, commonly known as the Wild Plum, is a species of plant in the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems due to its health benefits. The Wild Plum has therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in Prunus communis subsp. divaricata contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine for its potential to soothe various ailments.
